The '''Shadow Captain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial commando (Sith Empire)|Imperial Commando]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a member of the elite shadow commandos. In [[3643 BBY]], the Captain and his squad were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] during a [[Battle in the Brell Sediment laboratory|fight]] in one of [[Nasan Godera]]'s laboratories on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="TOR" />
